flagship_project.name: Project NeuroScreen: Zero-Latency On-Device Lockscreen Content Synthesis, Edge Multimodal Recommendation & Sovereign Privacy Vault
flagship_project.pillar: On-Device Edge Generative Media & Low-Latency Multimodal Recommendation
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Glance operates on 300M+ smartphone lockscreens globally. NeuroScreen deploys an on-device quantized multimodal transformer that synthesizes customized news, gaming, and interactive commerce in zero milliseconds without sending user browsing logs or biometric sensor data to cloud servers.
flagship_project.tech_stack: C++ / ONNX Runtime (On-Device Neural Engine), Rust (Edge Cache), PyTorch (Distributed Continual Learning), ClickHouse (Global Ad Yield Engine), Apache Flink, WebAssembly / Android NDK
flagship_project.kpis: Sub-1ms lockscreen render latency; 45% increase in user dwell time; zero user personal data leaks to third-party ad networks.
